says: Ana founds a Team whose policy needs one independent review to publish; Ben and Cho join by invitation, verified key and consent. Ana grants Ben read, use, contribute and publish, and grants a 'reviewers' group review with Cho as its approved member. Each of the following is refused by the owner's operation result and commits nothing: Ben changing the reviewers grant to add himself (group_membership_escalation); Ben approving his own sealed publication request (approver_not_independent); Ben publishing a changed edition while offering Cho's approval of the first request (request_mismatch); Ben approving a publication Ana submits that names him among its accountable_authors (approver_not_independent); Cho approving after Ana revoked the reviewers grant (grant_not_held); and a grant change sealed on the Team head from before Ana moved the policy to version 2, still naming version 1 (stale_base, reseal on the current head). Cho's approval of the first request, recorded while she held the grant, is the one approval that stands. Finally Ana's grant request for Ben is sent again under the same request id with other bytes and refused with request_id_conflict, and sent again with its identical bytes, which returns the original committed result with the same grant and commits nothing new.
